input.command: if command -v tmux >/dev/null; then tmux new-session -d -s brickserver 'python3 -m http.server 3002'; sleep 0.5; tmux has-session -t brickserver && curl -I --fail http://127.0.0.1:3002; else python3 -m http.server 3002; fi
